rows.64:1040:
Goes to show how you act every day really matters, huh?
You'd better watch yourself too, {a}.
...Anyway.
That time, it got chalked up to Shimada and his crowd of boys.
But the real problem came after that.
From that day on, things started going missing all over the class.
I heard all sorts of stories.
...Um, hold on a sec.
Let me remember...
There was Endo's pencil case.
Imai's key chain, and Matsumoto's commuter pass case.
Morioka was shrieking that her watch was gone, and Takigawa was upset because a book she'd borrowed from the library had vanished.
The girls in the class were in an uproar, saying there was a thief.
Oh yeah, I was a victim too, you know.
Somebody stole my precious wallet!
Classes were over for the day, and I opened my bag to get ready to go home, right?
And then...
There was money spilled all over the inside of my bag, jingling around.
I didn't want it scattering everywhere, so I hurried to gather it up.
I figured my wallet must have a hole in it, so I looked for it... but it wasn't there.
No matter where I searched in my bag, I couldn't find the wallet.
The charm and the hair salon card I'd kept inside it were still there, but the wallet itself was gone.{p}Isn't that awful?
rows.64:149c:
You sure don't mind saying cold things, do you, {a}?
...Sure, I'm glad what was inside was safe too.
But that wallet was precious to me. My big sister gave it to me as a present for getting into high school.
I loved it so much...
You don't even know that, and you go, 'If the stuff inside was safe...'? That's kind of insensitive.
Ugh, this is why I can't stand boys.
You're just like the boys in my class.
Even when the girls are in trouble, they act like it's none of their business.
Seriously, they're totally useless...{p}
rows.64:3b88:
...Right?
That wallet was a really special present my big sister gave me to celebrate getting into high school...
I absolutely loved it.
And yet...
The boys in my class said, if the stuff inside was safe, what's the big deal?
Honestly, how insensitive can you get?
Ugh, this is why I can't stand boys.{p}
rows.64:1c58:
That friend... her name's Sanae Motoki, and she's a really unusual girl.
Sometimes she says things that make no sense, but later it turns out they were important prophecies, which is scary.
But she's not a bad person at all.
There's just something about her you can't dislike...
...Oops, Sanae's got nothing to do with this right now.
Maybe I'll tell you about her some other time.
Only...
Sanae went,
"Ew. That one isn't keeping to their territory."
She muttered it under her breath.
Right in the classroom, while everyone was making a fuss about the stolen watch.
She clammed up after that, but it makes you wonder, right?{p}
rows.64:278c:
...I see.
Same as me.
I mean, you don't know what kind of person the thief is.
If they had a knife or something, you'd be the one in danger.
And unless you catch them red-handed, you're stuck if they play dumb.
I fought down the urge to burst out and stayed still in that cramped cleaning closet.
And then...
Right about when the presence I was sure was the thief reached the middle of the classroom, it suddenly just vanished.{p}
rows.64:3a7c:
Really? I wonder...
The other day I heard a window got broken in a first-year classroom during cleaning time...
Wasn't that Class E?
...Oh well, never mind.
Don't be too rough with the school's equipment, okay?{p}
rows.64:490c:
I'd been in the dark until then, so in an instant I couldn't see a thing.
...Oh right, it was still before noon.
I'm pretty sure that's what went through my head.
Ahaha, even though that was no time for it.
The blinding light wasn't coming in from the windows.{p}
rows.64:506c:
And so, here's what I think...
Maybe that rift was behind the string of thefts in our classroom.
Ever since Shimada got sucked in, the thefts stopped dead, after all.
Even now that he's missing, Shimada's still being blamed for the thefts.
Poor guy, right?
If that rift in space showed up again, people would see I wasn't lying, but then somebody else would have to be sacrificed, wouldn't they?
But that's way too scary, so I'd rather it never showed up.
Besides, I know how to close the rift, but I don't know what makes it open.
Sanae doesn't seem to know either...
When will that rift appear again...?
When I think about that, I just can't relax.
There's no saying it'll only show up in our classroom.
It could even appear right here, right now.{p}
